<file path="canvas/CanvasItem.js">
 1: import {HTMLItems} from '../../grid/RowTemplates.js';
 2: export class CanvasItem extends HTMLItems {
 3:     constructor({width, height, padWidth = 0, padHeight = 0, autoResize = false}) {
 4:         super('canvas');
 5:         this.attribute('width', width - padWidth)
 6:                 .attribute('height', height - padHeight)
 7:                 .width(width - padWidth)
 8:                 .height(height - padHeight);
 9:         this.padWidth = padWidth;
10:         this.padHeight = padHeight;
11:         if (autoResize)
12:             this.#_setUpAutoResize(); 
13:     }
14:     context(type='2d') {
15:         return this.render().getContext(type);
16:     }
17:     #_setUpAutoResize() {
18:         window.addEventListener('resize', (evt) => {
19:             this.attribute('width', window.innerWidth - this.padWidth);
20:             this.attribute('height', window.innerHeight - this.padHeight);
21:         });
22:     }
23: }
</file>

<file path="Gradient/Renderers/BarRenderer.js">
 1: import BaseRenderer from "./BaseRenderer.js";
 2: export class BarRenderer extends BaseRenderer {
 3:     render(renderContext, graph) {
 4:         const {ctx, canvasHeight, bufferLength, canvasWidth} = renderContext;
 5:         const barWidth = (canvasWidth / bufferLength);
 6:         let posX = 0;
 7:         // 1. Prepare the graph for the frame
 8:         graph.initialize(renderContext);
 9:         for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
10:             const audioValue = renderContext.dataArray[i];
11:             const barHeight = (audioValue + 140) * 2;
12:             const posY = canvasHeight - barHeight * 2;
13:             // 2. Get the specific color for THIS bar from the graph
14:             const { h, s, l, a } = graph.getColorAt(i, renderContext);
15:             // 3. Apply the color and draw the bar
16:             ctx.fillStyle = `hsla(${h}, ${s}%, ${l}%, ${a})`;
17:             ctx.fillRect(posX, posY, barWidth, barHeight * 2);
18:             // 4. Draw the text label
19:             ctx.fillStyle = `#f1f1f1`;
20:             ctx.fillText(
21:                 Math.round(barHeight).toString(), 
22:                 posX + (barWidth / 2), 
23:                 posY - 5
24:             );
25:             posX += barWidth + 1;
26:         }
27:     }
28: }
</file>

<file path="Gradient/Renderers/HorizontalGradientRenderer.js">
 1: import BaseRenderer from "./BaseRenderer.js";
 2: export class HorizontalGradientRenderer extends BaseRenderer {
 3:     render(renderContext, graph) {
 4:         const { dataArray, bufferLength, canvasWidth, canvasHeight, ctx } = renderContext;
 5:         const sliceWidth = canvasWidth / bufferLength;
 6:         let x = 0;
 7:         // 1. START OPTIMIZATION: Prepare a single path
 8:         ctx.beginPath();
 9:         // 2. GRADIENT OPTIMIZATION: Create a gradient for the whole width
10:         const gradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, canvasWidth, 0);
11:         let r, g, b;
12:         for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
13:             const audioValue = dataArray[i];
14:             const v = audioValue / 128.0;
15:             const y = (v * canvasHeight) / 2;
16:             renderContext.audioValue = audioValue;
17:             renderContext.i = i;
18:             // 3. Get color components from the subclass
19:             ({ r, g, b } = graph.getColorAt(i, renderContext));
20:             // 4. Add a color stop for this specific point (i / bufferLength is 0.0 to 1.0)
21:             // Note: Adding 2048 stops can be heavy; usually 10-20 stops is enough.
22:             if (i % 16 === 0 || i === bufferLength - 1) {
23:                 gradient.addColorStop(i / (bufferLength - 1), `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, .6)`);
24:             }
25:             // 5. Connect the coordinates
26:             graph.draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx);
27:             x += sliceWidth;
28:         }
29:         // 6. SINGLE STROKE: Apply the gradient and draw once
30:         ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;
31:         /*ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
32:         ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255, 50, 50, 0.6)`; // Add a purple glow*/
33:         ctx.stroke();
34:     }
35: }
</file>

<file path="Gradient/Renderers/RadialGradientRenderer.js">
 1: import BaseRenderer from "./BaseRenderer.js";
 2: export class RadialGradientRenderer extends BaseRenderer {
 3:     render(renderContext, graph) {
 4:         const { dataArray, bufferLength, canvasWidth, canvasHeight, ctx } = renderContext;
 5:         const step = Math.max(1, Math.floor(bufferLength / 900));
 6:         const sliceWidth = (canvasWidth / bufferLength) * step;
 7:         const centerY = (canvasHeight / 2) | 0;
 8:         // 2. GRADIENT OPTIMIZATION: Create a gradient for the whole width
 9:         // Center of the canvas
10:         const centerX = canvasWidth / 2;
11:         // Start radius 0, End radius max
12:         // const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(centerX, centerY, 0, centerX, centerY, canvasWidth / 2);
13:         const gradient = ctx.createRadialGradient(canvasWidth / 2, centerY, 0, canvasWidth / 2, centerY, canvasWidth / 2);
14:         gradient.addColorStop(0, `white`); 
15:         gradient.addColorStop(.1, 'rgb(255, 218, 96)');
16:         gradient.addColorStop(.20, 'rgb(255, 240, 109)');
17:         gradient.addColorStop(.4, 'rgb(253, 255, 125)');
18:         gradient.addColorStop(.65, 'rgb(255, 172, 104)');
19:         gradient.addColorStop(.8, 'rgb(255, 105, 105)');
20:         gradient.addColorStop(1.0, 'rgb(83, 163, 255)');
21:         // 1. START OPTIMIZATION: Prepare a single path
22:         ctx.beginPath();
23:         let r, g, b, x = 0;
24:         // PASS 1: FORWARD (Always happens)
25:         for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i += step) {
26:             const audioValue = dataArray[i];
27:             const v = audioValue / 128.0;
28:             const y = (v * canvasHeight) / 2;
29:             renderContext.audioValue = audioValue;
30:             renderContext.i = i;
31:             // Get colors from subclass
32:             ({ r, g, b } = graph.getColorAt(i, renderContext));
33:             // Call draw with your exact signature
34:             graph.draw(x | 0, y | 0, i, r, g, b, ctx, 'top');
35:             x += sliceWidth;
36:         }
37:         // PASS 2: BACKWARD (Conditional)
38:         // Access the static property from the instance's constructor
39:         if (graph.constructor.isMirror) {
40:         // Reset X to the end to walk backwards
41:             x = canvasWidth; 
42:             for (let i = bufferLength - 1; i >= 0; i -= step) {
43:                 const audioValue = dataArray[i];
44:                 const v = audioValue / 128.0;
45:                 const y = (v * canvasHeight) / 2;
46:                 renderContext.audioValue = audioValue;
47:                 renderContext.i = i;
48:                 ({ r, g, b } = graph.getColorAt(i, renderContext));
49:                 // Call draw backwards
50:                 graph.draw(x | 0, y | 0, i, r, g, b, ctx, 'bottom');
51:                 x -= sliceWidth;
52:             }
53:             ctx.closePath();
54:             ctx.fillStyle = gradient;
55:             ctx.fill();
56:         } else {
57:             // For non-mirrored, we just stroke the line
58:             ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;
59:             ctx.stroke();
60:         }
61:         // gradient.addColorStop(.1, `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 1)`); 
62:         // gradient.addColorStop(.5, `rgba(${b}, ${r}, ${g}, 1)`);
63:         // gradient.addColorStop(1, `rgba(${g}, ${b}, ${r}, 1)`);
64:     }
65: }
</file>

<file path="Gradient/Renderers/RendererFactory.js">
 1: import { HorizontalGradientRenderer } from "./HorizontalGradientRenderer.js";
 2: import { VerticalGradientRenderer } from "./VerticalGradientRenderer.js";
 3: import { RadialGradientRenderer } from "./RadialGradientRenderer.js";
 4: import { BarRenderer } from "./BarRenderer.js";
 5: const RendererFactory = {
 6:     // Map categories to Engine classes
 7:     mapping: {
 8:         'horizontal': HorizontalGradientRenderer,
 9:         'vertical': VerticalGradientRenderer,
10:         'radial': RadialGradientRenderer,
11:         'bar': BarRenderer
12:     },
13:     create(renderer, graph) {
14:         const RendererClass = this.mapping[renderer];
15:         if (!RendererClass) {
16:             // Default to BarChartEngine if category isn't found
17:             console.warn(`No renderer found for ${renderer}, defaulting to HorizontalGradientRenderer.`);
18:             return new HorizontalGradientRenderer(graph);
19:         }
20:         return new RendererClass(graph);
21:     }
22: };
23: export default RendererFactory;
</file>

13:         gradient.addColorStop(0.08, 'red'); 
14:         gradient.addColorStop(0.25, 'orange');
15:         gradient.addColorStop(0.5, 'purple'); // Silence (Center)
16:         gradient.addColorStop(0.75, 'orange');
17:         gradient.addColorStop(0.92, 'red');
18:         gradient.addColorStop(1.0, 'red');    // Trough (Loud)
19:         let r, g, b;
20:         for (let i = 0; i < bufferLength; i++) {
21:             const audioValue = dataArray[i];
22:             const v = audioValue / 128.0;

27:             ({ r, g, b } = graph.getColorAt(i, renderContext));
28:             // 5. Connect the coordinates
29:             graph.draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx);
30:             x += sliceWidth;
31:         }
32:         // 6. SINGLE STROKE: Apply the gradient and draw once
33:         ctx.strokeStyle = gradient;
34:         /*ctx.shadowBlur = 25;
35:         ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(255, 50, 50, 0.6)`; // Add a purple glow*/

37:     }

<file path="graphs/barchart/BarChartColorVizualizer.js">
  1: import { BaseChartColorVisualizer } from "../basevisualizers/BaseChartColorVisualizer.js";
  2: import VisualizerFactory from '../Factory.js';
  3: import { withNumericContext } from '../../../../core/Decorators/ContextDecorators.js'
  4: import { decorate } from '../../../../core/Decorators/Utils.js'
  5: class ClassicRed extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
  6:     static name = 'classic red';
  7:     static key = 'classic-red';
  8:     getColorAt(i, {dataArray}) {
  9:         const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray);
 10:         return this._rgbaToHsla(Math.floor((barHeight / 1.4) + 140), 50, 50, 0.66);
 11:     }
 12: }
 13: class MonoColor extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
 14:     static name = 'mono color';
 15:     static key = 'mono-color';
 16:     getColorAt(i, {dataArray, ctx, hue, saturation, light, alpha, pulse = false}) {
 17:         if (pulse) {
 18:             const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray);
 19:             const pulsed = this._pulseLigthness(barHeight);
 20:             light = pulsed;
 21:         }
 22:         return {h: hue, s: saturation, l: light, a: alpha}
 23:     }
 24: }
 25: decorate(MonoColor, 'getColorAt', withNumericContext({
 26:     hue: 180,
 27:     saturation: 100,
 28:     light: 75,
 29:     alpha: .6
 30: }));
 31: class RedToPurpel extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
 32:     static name = 'red to purple';
 33:     static key = 'red-to-purple';
 34:     /**
 35:      * COLOR: Runs for every bar.
 36:      * Takes the barHeight and determines the "Warm to Cold" color.
 37:      */
 38:     getColorAt(i, renderContext) {
 39:         // 1. Get the specific height for this bar
 40:         const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, renderContext.dataArray);
 41:         const maxRange = 190; 
 42:         const intensity = Math.min(barHeight / maxRange, 1);
 43:         // 2. The "Warm to Cold" Formula
 44:         // Low intensity (0) = 280 (Purple) -> High intensity (1) = 0 (Red)
 45:         const hue = 280 - (intensity * 280);
 46:         let light = 75;
 47:         if (renderContext.pulse) {
 48:             light = this._pulseLigthness(barHeight);
 49:         }
 50:         // Return the color components
 51:         return { 
 52:             h: hue, 
 53:             s: 100, 
 54:             l: light, 
 55:             a: 0.6 
 56:         };
 57:     }
 58: }
 59: class RedAndPurpel extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
 60:     static name = 'red and purple';
 61:     static key = 'red-and-purple';
 62:     getColorAt(i, {dataArray, saturation, light, alpha, ctx, pulse = false}) {
 63:         const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray);
 64:         const minThreshold = 40;  // Everything below this is pure Purple
 65:         const maxThreshold = 180; // Everything above this is pure Red
 66:         // Normalize barHeight to a 0-1 value within our specific window
 67:         return this._applyCompression(barHeight, minThreshold, maxThreshold, 280, saturation, light, alpha, pulse, ctx);
 68:     }
 69: }
 70: decorate(RedAndPurpel, 'getColorAt', withNumericContext({
 71:     saturation: 100,
 72:     light: 75,
 73:     alpha: .6
 74: }));
 75: class RedToOrange extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
 76:     static name = 'red to orange';
 77:     static key = 'red-to-orange';
 78:     getColorAt(i, {dataArray, saturation, light, alpha, ctx, pulse = false}) {
 79:         const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray);
 80:         const minThreshold = 50; 
 81:         const maxThreshold = 178;
 82:         return this._applyCompression(barHeight, minThreshold, maxThreshold, 35,  saturation, light, alpha, pulse, ctx);
 83:     }
 84: }
 85: decorate(RedToOrange, 'getColorAt', withNumericContext({
 86:     saturation: 100,
 87:     light: 75,
 88:     alpha: .6
 89: }));
 90: class RippleWaves extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
 91:     static name = 'ripple waves';
 92:     static key = 'ripple-waves';
 93:     getColorAt(i, {time, saturation, light, alpha, ctx, pulse = false}) {
 94:         const wave = Math.sin(i * 0.1 + time); 
 95:         const hue = 36 + (wave * 40);
 96:         if (pulse) {
 97:             const pulsed = this._pulseLigthness(barHeight);
 98:             light = pulsed;
 99:         }
100:         return {h: hue, s: saturation, l: light, a: alpha};
101:     }
102: }
103: decorate(RippleWaves, 'getColorAt', withNumericContext({
104:     saturation: 100,
105:     light: 75,
106:     alpha: .6
107: }));
108: class TrigBasedRGBPlasma extends BaseChartColorVisualizer {
109:     static name = 'trigonometry based RGB';
110:     static key = 'trigbased-rgb-plasma';
111:     getColorAt(i, {dataArray, alpha, ctx}) {
112:         // Normalize: Divide barHeight by your typical "max" (e.g., 300 or 400)
113:         // This ensures intensity stays between 0 and 1
114:         const barHeight = this._defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray);
115:         let intensity = barHeight / 1500;
116:         const timeOffset = Date.now() * 0.002;
117:         const dynamicIntensity = intensity + timeOffset;
118:         intensity = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, intensity)) //+ (timeOffset / 10);
119:         const r = Math.abs(Math.sin(intensity * Math.PI) * 255);
120:         const g = Math.abs(Math.cos(intensity * Math.PI * 0.5) * 255);
121:         const b = Math.abs(Math.sin(intensity * Math.PI + 2) * 255);
122:         return this._rgbaToHsla(r, g, b, alpha);
123:     }
124: }
125: decorate(TrigBasedRGBPlasma, 'getColorAt', withNumericContext({
126:     alpha: .6
127: }));
128: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'classic-red', ClassicRed);
129: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'mono-color', MonoColor);

131: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'red-and-purple', RedAndPurpel);
132: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'red-to-orange', RedToOrange);
133: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'ripple-waves', RippleWaves);
134: VisualizerFactory.register('barchart', 'trigbased-rgb-plasma', TrigBasedRGBPlasma);

<file path="graphs/basevisualizers/BaseChartColorVisualizer.js">
 1: import BaseVisualizer from "./BaseVisualizer.js"
 2: import {getFormatedDate} from '../../../../core/Utils.js';
 3: export class BaseChartColorVisualizer extends BaseVisualizer {
 4:     initialize(renderContext) {
 5:         const {ctx} = renderContext;
 6:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
 7:         ctx.font = "12px sans-serif";
 8:         ctx.textAlign = 'center';
 9:     }
10:     _pulseLigthness(barHeight) {
11:         let intensity = barHeight / 250;
12:         // Map intensity to a radian (0 to PI)
13:         const angle = intensity * Math.PI //+ (timeOffset / 2);
14:         // Lightness will be highest (70%) when intensity is at 0.5PI (the peak of the curve)
15:         // and lowest at the ends.
16:         return 40 + Math.sin(angle) * 30;
17:     }
18:     _applyCompression = (barHeight, minThreshold, maxThreshold, coef, saturation, light, alpha, pulse = false, ctx) => {
19:         let intensity = (barHeight - minThreshold) / (maxThreshold - minThreshold);
20:         // Clamp the value between 0 and 1 so the math doesn't "loop" the color wheel
21:         intensity = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, intensity));
22:         // --- RANGE COMPRESSION END ---
23:         // Apply the same Warm-to-Cold formula
24:         const hue = coef - (intensity * coef);
25:         if (pulse) {
26:             const pulsed = this._pulseLigthness(barHeight);
27:             light = pulsed;
28:         }
29:         return {h: hue, s: saturation, l: light, a: alpha};
30:     }
31:     process(renderContext, renderer) {
32:         const {ctx} = renderContext;
33:         renderer.render(renderContext, this);
34:         this._displayOverlay(getFormatedDate(), ctx);
35:     }
36:     _displayOverlay(dateText, ctx) {
37:         ctx.font = "25px sans-serif";
38:         ctx.textAlign = 'left';
39:         ctx.fillStyle = `#f1f1f1`;
40:         ctx.fillText(dateText, 10, 36);
41:     }
42:     _defaultCalculationBarHeight(i, dataArray) {
43:         return (dataArray[i] + 140) * 2;
44:     }
45: }
</file>

<file path="graphs/basevisualizers/BaseVisualizer.js">
 1: export default class BaseVisualizer {
 2:     static name = '';
 3:     static key = '';
 4:     constructor(renderer) {
 5:         // this.renderer = renderer;
 6:         // this.renderer.setGraph(this); // circular reference here
 7:     }
 8:     initialize({...args}) {}
 9:     getColorAt(i, renderContext, ...args) {}
10:     draw(...args) {}
11:     process() {}
12:     _displayOverlay(...args) {}
13:     /**
14:      * Converts RGBA to HSLA.
15:      * @param {number} r 0-255
16:      * @param {number} g 0-255
17:      * @param {number} b 0-255
18:      * @param {number} a 0-1 (optional)
19:      * @returns {object} { h, s, l, a }
20:      */
21:     _rgbaToHsla(r, g, b, a = 1) {
22:         r /= 255;
23:         g /= 255;
24:         b /= 255;
25:         const max = Math.max(r, g, b);
26:         const min = Math.min(r, g, b);
27:         let h, s, l = (max + min) / 2;
28:         if (max === min) {
29:             h = s = 0; // Achromatic (gray)
30:         } else {
31:             const d = max - min;
32:             s = l > 0.5 ? d / (2 - max - min) : d / (max + min);
33:             switch (max) {
34:                 case r: h = (g - b) / d + (g < b ? 6 : 0); break;
35:                 case g: h = (b - r) / d + 2; break;
36:                 case b: h = (r - g) / d + 4; break;
37:             }
38:             h /= 6;
39:         }
40:         return {
41:             h: Math.round(h * 360),
42:             s: Math.round(s * 100),
43:             l: Math.round(l * 100),
44:             a: a
45:         };
46:     }
47: }
</file>

<file path="graphs/basevisualizers/BaseWaveColorVisualizer.js">
 1: import BaseVisualizer from "./BaseVisualizer.js";
 2: import {getFormatedDate} from '../../../../core/Utils.js';
 3: export class BaseWaveColorVisualizer extends BaseVisualizer {
 4:     initialize({ time }) {
 5:         this.baseHue = (time * 126) % 360;
 6:         // We don't return {r,g,b} here anymore because the Renderer 
 7:         // will ask getColorAt for them inside the loop.
 8:     }
 9:     // 2. SAMPLING: Calculate the color for a specific point "i"
10:     getColorAt(i, renderContext) {
11:         // We take the base (time) and add a shift based on position (i)
12:         // Adjust '0.2' to make the rainbow colors closer together or further apart
13:         const pointHue = (this.baseHue + (i * 0.2)) % 360;
14:         return this._hslToRgb(pointHue, 100, 70);
15:     }
16:     process(renderContext, renderer) {
17:         this.initialize(renderContext);
18:         const dateText = getFormatedDate();
19:         const {ctx} = renderContext;
20:         renderer.render(renderContext, this);
21:         this._displayOverlay(dateText, ctx);
22:     }
23:     _displayOverlay(dateText, ctx) {
24:         ctx.font = "25px sans-serif";
25:         ctx.textAlign = 'left';
26:         ctx.fillStyle = `#f1f1f1`;
27:         ctx.fillText(dateText, 10, 36);
28:     }
29: }

 2: import { BarChartEngine, WaveformEngine } from './VisualizerEngines.js';
 3: const EngineFactory = {
 4:     // Map categories to Engine classes
 5:     mapping: {
 6:         'barchart': BarChartEngine,
 7:         'waveform': WaveformEngine,
 8:         // 'particles': ParticlePhysicsEngine,  <-- Future expansion
 9:         // 'webgl': ThreeJSEngine,              <-- Future expansion
10:     },

12:         const EngineClass = this.mapping[category];
13:         if (!EngineClass) {
14:             // Default to BarChartEngine if category isn't found
15:             console.warn(`No engine found for ${category}, defaulting to BarChart.`);
16:             return new BarChartEngine();
17:         }
18:         return new EngineClass();
19:     }
20: };

<file path="graphs/engines/VisualizerEngines.js">
 1: import BaseEngine from "./BaseEngine.js";
 2: export class BarChartEngine extends BaseEngine {
 3:     async setup(audioPlayer, fftSize = 256) {
 4:         // 1. Connect the source (the "Input Jack")
 5:         this.audioSourceNode = this.audioEngine.connectSource(audioPlayer.audioElem);
 6:         // 2. Configure the analyzer via the engine service
 7:         const { analyser, bufferLength } = this.audioEngine.analyser().setAnalyserConfig(fftSize ?? 256);
 8:         this.analyserNode = analyser;
 9:         this.bufferLength = bufferLength;
10:         // 3. Prepare the data array specifically for BarChart requirements
11:         // BarCharts typically use Frequency data (Float32)
12:         this.dataArray = new Float32Array(this.bufferLength);
13:         this._buildContext();
14:     }
15:     update() {
16:         if (!this.analyserNode) return;
17:         // This method pulls fresh data from the hardware
18:         this.analyserNode.getFloatFrequencyData(this.dataArray);
19:     }
20: }
21: export class WaveformEngine extends BaseEngine {
22:     async setup(audioPlayer, fftSize = 2048) {
23:         this.audioSourceNode = this.audioEngine.connectSource(audioPlayer.audioElem);
24:         // 2. Configure the analyzer via the engine service
25:         const { analyser, bufferLength } = this.audioEngine.analyser().setAnalyserConfig(fftSize ?? 2048);
26:         this.analyserNode = analyser;
27:         this.bufferLength = bufferLength;
28:         this.dataArray = new Uint8Array(this.bufferLength);
29:         // console.log(this.audioEngine.source.connect(this.audioEngine.ctx.destination));
30:         this._buildContext();
31:     }
32:     update() {
33:         if (!this.analyserNode) return;
34:         this.analyserNode.getByteTimeDomainData(this.dataArray);
35:     }
36: }

<file path="graphs/waveform/WaveformVisualizer.js">

  3: class WaveformVisualizer extends BaseWaveColorVisualizer {
  4:     static name = 'wave form visualizer';
  5:     static key = 'waveform-visualizer';
  6:     /**
  7:      * SETUP: Called once per frame.
  8:      * Use this to set the 'base' state for the frame.
  9:      */
 10:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
 11:         // We can define a base hue that shifts over time
 12:         this.currentBaseHue = (time * 50) % 360;
 13:         // Set global styles for the stroke
 14:         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
 15:         ctx.lineCap = 'round';
 16:         ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
 17:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
 18:     }
 19:     /**
 20:      * COLOR: Called by the Renderer inside the loop.
 21:      * This defines the "Color Personality".
 22:      */
 23:     getColorAt(i, renderContext) {
 24:         // For a classic oscilloscope green:
 25:         return { r: 0, g: 255, b: 0 };
 26:         // OR for a subtle rainbow shift:
 27:         // const pointHue = (this.currentBaseHue + (i * 0.1)) % 360;
 28:         // return this._hslToRgb(pointHue, 100, 50);
 29:     }
 30:     /**
 31:      * COORDINATES: Called by the Renderer inside the loop.
 32:      * This defines the "Shape Personality".
 33:      */
 34:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx) {
 35:         // The Renderer handles the 'beginPath' and 'stroke'.
 36:         // We only handle the line segments.
 37:         if (i === 0) {
 38:             ctx.moveTo(x, y);
 39:         } else {
 40:             ctx.lineTo(x, y);
 41:         }
 42:     }

 44: class NeonPulseWave extends BaseWaveColorVisualizer {
 45:     static name = 'neon pulse wave';
 46:     static key = 'neon-pulse-wave';
 47:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
 48:         // Setup global frame state
 49:         this.time = time;
 50:         ctx.lineWidth = 3;
 51:         ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
 52:         // We can't calculate a single intensity here if we want the 
 53:         // colors to ripple along the wave.
 54:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
 55:     }
 56:     getColorAt(i, { dataArray, time }) {
 57:         // 1. Get the intensity for THIS specific point in the audio
 58:         const audioValue = dataArray[i];
 59:         const intensity = Math.abs(audioValue - 128) / 128;
 60:         // 2. Use that local intensity to calculate the RGB
 61:         // Using Math.sin/cos creates that "pulsing" neon transition
 62:         const r = Math.abs(Math.sin(intensity * Math.PI + time) * 255);
 63:         const g = Math.abs(Math.cos(intensity * Math.PI) * 255);
 64:         const b = 200; 
 65:         return { r, g, b };
 66:     }
 67:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx) {
 68:         if (i === 0) {
 69:             ctx.moveTo(x, y);
 70:         } else {
 71:             ctx.lineTo(x, y);
 72:         }
 73:     }
 74: }
 75: class MirrorOscilloscope extends BaseMirrorWaveColorVisualizer {
 76:     static name = 'mirror oscilloscope';
 77:     static key = 'mirror-oscilloscope-wave';
 78:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
 79:         this.time = time;
 80:         // Setup styles once per frame
 81:         ctx.lineWidth = 2; // Moved from draw() for performance
 82:         ctx.lineJoin = 'miter'; 
 83:         // Note: You had shadowBlur set to 20, but no shadowColor.
 84:         // If you want a glow, uncomment the line below:
 85:         // ctx.shadowBlur = 20;
 86:         // ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(0, 191, 255, 0.5)'; 
 87:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
 88:     }
 89:     getColorAt(i) {
 90:         const r = this._shiftColor(0, i), 
 91:               g = this._shiftColor(191, i), 
 92:               b = 255;
 93:         return { r, g, b };
 94:     }
 95:     // Normalized to accept 'side'
 96:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx, side) {
 97:         const centerY = (ctx.canvas.height / 2) | 0;
 98:         const offset = (y - centerY) | 0;
 99:         if (side === 'top') {
100:             // Forward Path
101:             if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, centerY + offset);
102:             else ctx.lineTo(x, centerY + offset);
103:         } else {
104:             // Backward Path (Mirrored)
105:             ctx.lineTo(x, centerY - offset);
106:         }
107:     }
108:     _shiftColor(colorVal, i) {
109:         // We use Math.sin to make the color "wave" back and forth 
110:         // rather than just hitting 255 and staying there (clamping).
111:         // 0.05 is a 'speed' multiplier for the spatial shift.
112:         const shift = Math.sin(this.time + i * 0.05) * 50; 
113:         return Math.floor(Math.max(0, Math.min(255, colorVal + shift)));
114:     }
115: }
116: class CyclingMirrorOscilloscope extends BaseMirrorWaveColorVisualizer {
117:     static name = 'cycling mirror oscilloscope';
118:     static key = 'cycling-mirror-oscilloscope-wave';
119:     initialize({ time, ctx }) {
120:         // 1. Store time for the getColorAt method
121:         this.time = time;
122:         // 2. Setup styles once per frame (Performance win!)
123:         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
124:         ctx.lineJoin = 'miter'; // 'miter' is faster than 'round' for complex paths
125:         ctx.lineCap = 'butt';
126:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
127:     }
128:     // Added 'renderContext' as a second argument to access data if needed
129:     getColorAt(i, { time }) {
130:         // Fix: Use the 'time' passed from the context or 'this.time'
131:         // Using (i / 2) creates a nice spatial spread across the wave
132:         const hue = (time * 50 + (i / 2)) % 360;
133:         return this._hslToRgb(hue, 100, 70);
134:     }
135:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx, side) {
136:         const centerY = (ctx.canvas.height / 2) | 0;
137:         const offset = (y - centerY) | 0;
138:         if (side === 'top') {
139:             // If it's the start of the buffer, move to position
140:             if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, centerY + offset);
141:             else ctx.lineTo(x, centerY + offset);
142:         } else {
143:             // This draws the mirrored part (Pass 2)
144:             // No moveTo needed here if we want a closed loop, 
145:             // the last lineTo from the top pass connects to the first of the bottom pass
146:             ctx.lineTo(x, centerY - offset);
147:         }
148:     }
149:     _hslToRgb(h, s, l) {
150:         l /= 100;
151:         const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l) / 100;
152:         const f = n => {
153:             const k = (n + h / 30) % 12;
154:             const color = l - a * Math.max(Math.min(k - 3, 9 - k, 1), -1);
155:             return Math.round(255 * color);
156:         };
157:         return { r: f(0), g: f(8), b: f(4) };
158:     }
159: }
160: class HeatmapCyclingMirrorOscilloscope extends BaseMirrorWaveColorVisualizer {
161:     static name = 'heatmap cycling mirror oscilloscope';
162:     static key = 'heatmap-cycling-mirror-oscilloscope-wave';
163:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
164:         this.rollingBaseline = (time * 0.4) % 360;
165:         ctx.lineWidth = 3;
166:         ctx.lineCap = 'round';
167:         ctx.lineJoin = 'round';
168:         ctx.shadowBlur = 15;
169:         // Setting a global fallback shadow based on the rolling baseline is safer 
170:         // for single-fill paths than per-vertex shadows.
171:         const fallbackRgb = this._hslToRgb(this.rollingBaseline, 100, 50);
172:         ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${fallbackRgb.r}, ${fallbackRgb.g}, ${fallbackRgb.b}, 0.6)`;
173:     }
174:     getColorAt(i, { dataArray }) {
175:         const audioValue = dataArray[i];
176:         const deviation = Math.abs(audioValue - 128);
177:         const intensity = Math.min(1, deviation / 128); 
178:         const reactiveHue = intensity * 270; 
179:         const finalHue = (this.rollingBaseline + reactiveHue) % 360;
180:         return this._hslToRgb(finalHue, 100, 50);
181:     }
182:     // 2. NORMALIZE DRAW METHOD: Match the signature and use the 'side' logic
183:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx, side) {
184:         // Optional: Update the shadow color dynamically. 
185:         // Be aware that only the final computed color of the loop will apply to the fill.
186:         ctx.shadowColor = `rgba(${r}, ${g}, ${b}, 0.6)`; 
187:         const centerY = (ctx.canvas.height / 2) | 0;
188:         const offset = (y - centerY) | 0;
189:         if (side === 'top') {
190:             // Forward Path
191:             if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x, centerY + offset);
192:             else ctx.lineTo(x, centerY + offset);
193:         } else {
194:             // Backward Path
195:             ctx.lineTo(x, centerY - offset);
196:         }
197:     }
198:     _hslToRgb(h, s, l) {
199:         l /= 100;
200:         const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l) / 100;
201:         const f = n => {
202:             const k = (n + h / 30) % 12;
203:             const color = l - a * Math.max(Math.min(k - 3, 9 - k, 1), -1);
204:             return Math.round(255 * color);
205:         };
206:         return { r: f(0), g: f(8), b: f(4) };
207:     }
208: }
209: class RainbowMirrorWave extends BaseMirrorWaveColorVisualizer {
210:     static name = 'rainbow mirror oscilloscope';
211:     static key = 'rainbow-mirror-oscilloscope-wave'; // Fixed: This was accidentally 'name' before
212:     /**
213:      * SETUP: Runs once per frame.
214:      */
215:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
216:         // We calculate the base starting point for the rainbow.
217:         // Storing it on 'this' allows us to reference it in getColorAt.
218:         this.baseHue = (time * 126) % 360;
219:         // Set global styles for the frame.
220:         ctx.lineWidth = 2;
221:         ctx.lineCap = 'round';
222:         ctx.lineJoin = 'miter'; // Recommended for single continuous paths to prevent vertex lag
223:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0)';
224:     }
225:     /**
226:      * COLOR: Called by the Renderer for the gradient stops.
227:      * This turns the "Solid Color" into a "Spatial Rainbow".
228:      */
229:     getColorAt(i) {
230:         // (i * 0.2) determines how many colors are visible at once.
231:         // Smaller numbers = subtle transition. Larger = full rainbow.
232:         const pointHue = (this.baseHue + (i * 0.2)) % 360;
233:         return this._hslToRgb(pointHue, 100, 70);
234:     }
235:     /**
236:      * DRAW: Carves the mirrored path.
237:      * Normalized to use the 'side' parameter for two-pass rendering.
238:      */
239:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx, side) {
240:         const centerY = (ctx.canvas.height / 2) | 0;
241:         const offset = (y - centerY) | 0;
242:         if (side === 'top') {
243:             // Forward Path
244:             if (i === 0) ctx.moveTo(x | 0, (centerY + offset) | 0);
245:             else ctx.lineTo(x | 0, (centerY + offset) | 0);
246:         } else {
247:             // Backward Path (Mirrored)
248:             ctx.lineTo(x | 0, (centerY - offset) | 0);
249:         }
250:     }
251:     _hslToRgb(h, s, l) {
252:         l /= 100;
253:         const a = s * Math.min(l, 1 - l) / 100;
254:         const f = n => {
255:             const k = (n + h / 30) % 12;
256:             const color = l - a * Math.max(Math.min(k - 3, 9 - k, 1), -1);
257:             return Math.round(255 * color);
258:         };
259:         return { r: f(0), g: f(8), b: f(4) };
260:     }
261: }
262: class SolidMountainWave extends BaseWaveColorVisualizer {
263:     static name = 'solid mountain wave';
264:     static key = 'solid-mountain-wave';
265:     /**
266:      * SETUP: Runs once per frame.
267:      */
268:     initialize({ ctx, time }) {
269:         this.time = time;
270:         // For a "Mountain", a subtle glow at the top edge looks great
271:         ctx.shadowBlur = 10;
272:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(255, 50, 255, 0.3)';
273:     }
274:     /**
275:      * COLOR: Defines the shifting purple/pink spectrum.
276:      */
277:     getColorAt(i, { time }) {
278:         // We use the same math you had, but now it can shift per-point
279:         // adding (i * 0.01) creates a slight color drift across the mountain range
280:         const r = Math.abs(Math.sin(time + i * 0.01) * 100) + 155;
281:         const g = 50;
282:         const b = 255;
283:         return { r, g, b };
284:     }
285:     /**
286:      * DRAW: Defines the "Mountain" silhouette.
287:      */
288:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx) {
289:         const canvasHeight = ctx.canvas.height;
290:         const canvasWidth = ctx.canvas.width;
291:         if (i === 0) {
292:             // 1. Start at the bottom-left corner
293:             ctx.moveTo(0, canvasHeight); 
294:             // 2. Line up to the first audio data point
295:             ctx.lineTo(x, y);
296:         } else {
297:             // 3. Trace the waveform
298:             ctx.lineTo(x, y);
299:         }
300:         // 4. On the last point, drop down to the bottom-right and close the shape
301:         // Note: Check if your renderer passes bufferLength, otherwise use renderContext
302:         if (i === 2047) { // Assuming bufferLength - 1
303:             ctx.lineTo(canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
304:             ctx.closePath();
305:             /* CRITICAL PEER NOTE:
306:                Since your base 'process' method likely calls ctx.stroke(), 
307:                you should call ctx.fill() here. 
308:                The renderer will apply the gradient to the fill!
309:             */
310:             ctx.fillStyle = ctx.strokeStyle; // Syncs the gradient to the fill
311:             ctx.fill();
312:         }
313:     }
314: }
315: class DigitalFragmentWave extends BaseWaveColorVisualizer {
316:     static name = 'digital fragment wave';
317:     static key = 'digital-fragment-wave';
318:     /**
319:      * SETUP: Runs once per frame.
320:      */
321:     initialize({ ctx }) {
322:         // Since we are drawing individual blocks, we don't need a glow on a path,
323:         // but a shadow on the context can make the fragments look like they are glowing.
324:         ctx.shadowBlur = 8;
325:         ctx.shadowColor = 'rgba(94, 255, 94, 0.5)';
326:     }
327:     /**
328:      * COLOR: Calculates the yellow-to-white intensity for each fragment.
329:      */
330:     getColorAt(i, { dataArray }) {
331:         const audioValue = dataArray[i];
332:         const intensity = Math.abs(audioValue - 128) / 128;
333:         // As intensity increases, it moves from Yellow towards pure White
334:         return { 
335:             r: Math.floor(127 * intensity),
336:             g: 255, 
337:             b: Math.floor(255 * intensity) // Adding a bit of blue at high intensity makes it "whiter" 'rgba(0, 255, 0, 0.8)'
338:         };
339:     }
340:     /**
341:      * DRAW: Draws the digital particles.
342:      */
343:     draw(x, y, i, r, g, b, ctx) {
344:         // 1. Every 4th point check to maintain your performance optimization
345:         if (i % 4 === 0) {
346:             // 2. Set the color for this specific fragment
347:             ctx.fillStyle = `rgb(${r}, ${g}, ${b})`;
348:             // 3. Draw the 3x3 square
349:             ctx.fillRect(x, y, 3, 3);
350:             // 4. Optional: Add a "mirror" fragment for symmetry if you like that look
351:             // const centerY = ctx.canvas.height / 2;
352:             // const offset = y - centerY;
353:             // ctx.fillRect(x, centerY - offset, 3, 3);
354:         }
355:         /* PEER NOTE: 
356:            Since the Renderer will call ctx.stroke() at the end of the loop,
357:            and we haven't used moveTo/lineTo, it will effectively do nothing.
358:            This is fine! It keeps the class compatible with the logic flow.
359:         */
360:     }
361: }

<file path="graphs/Factory.js">
 1: const VisualizerFactory = {
 2:     // Structure: { 'bar': Map, 'radial': Map, 'physics': Map }
 3:     categories: new Map(),
 4:     register(category, type, cls) {
 5:         if (!this.categories.has(category)) {
 6:             this.categories.set(category, new Map());
 7:         }
 8:         this.categories.get(category).set(type, cls);
 9:     },
10:     create(category, type, ...args) {
11:         const cat = this.categories.get(category);
12:         if (!cat) throw new Error(`Category ${category} not found`);
13:         const cls = cat.get(type);
14:         if (!cls) throw new Error(`Type ${type} not found in ${category}`);
15:         return new cls(...args);
16:     },
17:     getManifest() {
18:         const manifest = {};
19:         this.categories.forEach((map, catName) => {
20:             manifest[catName] = Array.from(map.values().map(visCls => [visCls.name, visCls.key]));
21:         });
22:         return manifest;
23:     }
24: }
25: export default VisualizerFactory;
</file>

<file path="slideshows/renderers/ImageRenderer.js">
 1: export class ImageRenderer {
 2:     static render(renderContext, img, transform) {
 3:         const { ctx, canvasWidth, canvasHeight } = renderContext;
 4:         const { scale, alpha, offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0 } = transform;
 5:         // 1. Clear the frame
 6:         ctx.fillStyle = "#181717";
 7:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
 8:         if (!img) return;
 9:         // 2. Calculate dimensions based on the scale provided by the strategy
10:         const w = img.width * scale;
11:         const h = img.height * scale;
12:         // 3. Center the image
13:         const x = (canvasWidth / 2) - (w / 2) + offsetX; // Apply the glitch shift!
14:         const y = (canvasHeight / 2) - (h / 2) + offsetY;
15:         // 4. Paint
16:         ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
17:         ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, w, h);
18:         ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
19:     }
20: }
</file>

<file path="slideshows/strategies/AnimationFactory.js">
 1: // AnimationFactory.js
 2: export class AnimationFactory {
 3:     // Private registry of strategies
 4:     static #registry = new Map();
 5:     /**
 6:      * Registers a new animation strategy.
 7:      * @param {string} key - The name used to identify the animation.
 8:      * @param {class} StrategyClass - The class definition.
 9:      */
10:     static register(key, StrategyClass) {
11:         this.#registry.set(key, StrategyClass);
12:         console.log(`Animation registered: ${key}`);
13:     }
14:     /**
15:      * Creates an instance of a registered strategy.
16:      */
17:     static create(key, config = {}) {
18:         const StrategyClass = this.#registry.get(key);
19:         if (!StrategyClass) {
20:             console.warn(`Strategy "${key}" not found. Falling back to default.`);
21:             // You can return a default or the first one registered
22:             const DefaultClass = this.#registry.values().next().value;
23:             return DefaultClass ? new DefaultClass(config) : null;
24:         }
25:         return new StrategyClass(config);
26:     }
27:     static getAvailableTypes() {
28:         return Array.from(this.#registry.keys());
29:     }
30: }

<file path="slideshows/strategies/AnimationStrategies.js">
  1: import { BaseProcessor, api } from "../../VisualizerManager.js";
  2: import { AnimationFactory } from "./AnimationFactory.js";
  3: class BaseAnimation {
  4:     constructor(config = {}) {
  5:         this.alphaCoef = 0;
  6:         this.doFadeIn = true;
  7:         this.config = {
  8:             maxAlphaCoef: 2328,
  9:             zoomThreshold: 610,
 10:             fadeSpeed: 10,
 11:             ...config
 12:         };
 13:     }
 14:     // This replaces the logic inside your process loop
 15:     update() {
 16:         if (this.doFadeIn) {
 17:             this.alphaCoef += this.config.fadeSpeed;
 18:             if (this.alphaCoef >= this.config.maxAlphaCoef) this.doFadeIn = false;
 19:         } else {
 20:             this.alphaCoef -= this.config.fadeSpeed;
 21:             if (this.alphaCoef <= 0) {
 22:                 this.alphaCoef = 0;
 23:                 this.doFadeIn = true;
 24:                 return true; // Signal that the cycle finished (time to swap images)
 25:             }
 26:         }
 27:         return false;
 28:     }
 29:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 30:         throw new Error("getTransform must be implemented by subclass");
 31:     }
 32: }
 33: export class PulseZoomStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 34:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 35:         if (!img)
 36:             return { scale: 0, alpha: 0 };
 37:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 38:         const coef = (canvasH / img.height) * (1.05 + (this.alphaCoef / 3008));
 39:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 40:         return { scale: coef, alpha: alpha };
 41:     }
 42: }
 43: // Strategy 2: A simple static fade (no movement)
 44: export class StaticStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 45:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 46:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 47:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.05; // Fixed scale
 48:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 49:         return { scale, alpha };
 50:     }
 51: }
 52: export class GlitchStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 53:     constructor(config = {}) {
 54:         super(config);
 55:         this.jitterX = 0;
 56:         this.jitterY = 0;
 57:     }
 58:     update() {
 59:         // 1. Run the normal fade in/out logic
 60:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
 61:         // 2. Add some "Randomness"
 62:         // Most of the time (95%), no jitter. 
 63:         // 5% of the time, create a sudden offset.
 64:         if (Math.random() > 0.95) {
 65:             this.jitterX = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40; // Shift up to 20px
 66:             this.jitterY = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 40;
 67:         } else {
 68:             // Quickly "ease" back to zero jitter
 69:             this.jitterX *= 0.8;
 70:             this.jitterY *= 0.8;
 71:         }
 72:         return cycleFinished;
 73:     }
 74:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
 75:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
 76:         // Base scale + a tiny bit of "shiver" from the jitter
 77:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * (1.05 + (Math.abs(this.jitterX) / 2000));
 78:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
 79:         return { 
 80:             scale, 
 81:             alpha,
 82:             // We can pass extra data like offsets to our Renderer!
 83:             offsetX: this.jitterX,
 84:             offsetY: this.jitterY
 85:         };
 86:     }
 87: }
 88: export class PanScanStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
 89:     constructor(config = {}) {
 90:         super(config);
 91:         // We want to track the "horizontal progress"
 92:         this.panProgress = 0;
 93:         this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
 94:     }
 95:     update() {
 96:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
 97:         // While the image is fading in/staying visible, we move the pan
 98:         // We use a very small increment so it looks smooth
 99:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
100:             this.panProgress += 0.001; 
101:         }
102:         // Reset the pan when the image is fully hidden
103:         if (cycleFinished) {
104:             this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
105:             this.panProgress = 0;
106:         }
107:         return cycleFinished;
108:     }
109:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
110:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
111:         // 1. We scale it slightly larger than the screen so we have "room" to slide
112:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.2;
113:         // 2. Standard Alpha logic
114:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
115:         // 3. Calculate the Pan Offset
116:         // We figure out how much "extra" width we have, then multiply by progress
117:         const scaledWidth = img.width * scale;
118:         const extraWidth = scaledWidth - canvas.attribute('width');
119:         // Slide from +extraWidth/2 to -extraWidth/2
120:         const offsetX = (extraWidth / 2) - (this.panProgress * extraWidth);
121:         return { 
122:             scale, 
123:             alpha,
124:             offsetX: offsetX * this.direction,
125:             offsetY: 0 
126:         };
127:     }
128: }
129: export class SmartPanStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
130:     constructor(config = {}) {
131:         super(config);
132:         this.panProgress = 0;
133:         this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
134:     }
135:     update() {
136:         const cycleFinished = super.update();
137:         // Only progress the pan if we are in a visible state
138:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
139:             this.panProgress += 0.001; 
140:         }
141:         if (cycleFinished) {
142:             this.panProgress = 0;
143:             this.direction = Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1;
144:         }
145:         return cycleFinished;
146:     }
147:     getTransform(canvas, img) {
148:         const canvasW = canvas.attribute('width');
149:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
150:         // 1. "Cover" Logic: Ensure the image at least fills the whole canvas
151:         const scaleW = canvasW / img.width;
152:         const scaleH = canvasH / img.height;
153:         // Use the larger of the two scales so no black bars are visible,
154:         // then add our 1.1 buffer to guarantee room for movement.
155:         const scale = Math.max(scaleW, scaleH) * 1.1; 
156:         const scaledWidth = img.width * scale;
157:         const extraWidth = scaledWidth - canvasW;
158:         // 2. The Pan Logic
159:         // Even if it's portrait, it's now wide enough to slide
160:         const offsetX = (extraWidth / 2) - (this.panProgress * extraWidth);
161:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, this.alphaCoef)) / 1000;
162:         return { 
163:             scale, 
164:             alpha, 
165:             offsetX, 
166:             offsetY: 0 
167:         };
168:     }
169: }
170: export class CrossfadeStrategy extends BaseAnimation {
171:     constructor(config = {}) {
172:         super(config);
173:         this.nextAlpha = 0;
174:     }
175:     update() {
176:         // 1. Fade the current one out
177:         if (this.alphaCoef > 0) {
178:             this.alphaCoef -= this.config.fadeSpeed;
179:         }
180:         // 2. Fade the next one in at the same time
181:         this.nextAlpha += this.config.fadeSpeed;
182:         // 3. Cycle ends when the next image is fully opaque
183:         if (this.nextAlpha >= this.config.maxAlphaCoef) {
184:             this.alphaCoef = this.config.maxAlphaCoef; // Reset for next cycle
185:             this.nextAlpha = 0;
186:             return true; 
187:         }
188:         return false;
189:     }
190:     getTransform(canvas, img, isNext = false) {
191:         const canvasH = canvas.attribute('height');
192:         const scale = (canvasH / img.height) * 1.05;
193:         // Use the correct alpha depending on if we are drawing the "Outgoing" or "Incoming" image
194:         const targetCoef = isNext ? this.nextAlpha : this.alphaCoef;
195:         const alpha = Math.min(this.config.zoomThreshold, Math.max(0, targetCoef)) / 1000;
196:         return { scale, alpha };
197:     }
198: }
199: AnimationFactory.register('static', StaticStrategy);
200: AnimationFactory.register('pulse-zoom', PulseZoomStrategy);
201: AnimationFactory.register('glitch', GlitchStrategy);
202: AnimationFactory.register('pan-scan', PanScanStrategy);
203: AnimationFactory.register('smart-pan', SmartPanStrategy);
204: AnimationFactory.register('crossfade', CrossfadeStrategy);
</file>

2: import { ImageRenderer } from "./renderers/ImageRenderer.js";
3: import './strategies/AnimationStrategies.js';
4: export { AnimationFactory, ImageRenderer };

 59: <file path="renderers/ImageRenderer.js">
 60:  1: export class ImageRenderer {
 61:  2:     static render(renderContext, img, transform) {
 62:  3:         const { ctx, canvasWidth, canvasHeight } = renderContext;
 63:  4:         const { scale, alpha, offsetX = 0, offsetY = 0 } = transform;
 64:  5:         // 1. Clear the frame
 65:  6:         ctx.fillStyle = "#181717";
 66:  7:         ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvasWidth, canvasHeight);
 67:  8:         if (!img) return;
 68:  9:         // 2. Calculate dimensions based on the scale provided by the strategy
 69: 10:         const w = img.width * scale;
 70: 11:         const h = img.height * scale;
 71: 12:         // 3. Center the image
 72: 13:         const x = (canvasWidth / 2) - (w / 2) + offsetX; // Apply the glitch shift!
 73: 14:         const y = (canvasHeight / 2) - (h / 2) + offsetY;
 74: 15:         // 4. Paint
 75: 16:         ctx.globalAlpha = alpha;
 76: 17:         ctx.drawImage(img, x, y, w, h);
 77: 18:         ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
 78: 19:     }
 79: 20: }

 82: <file path="strategies/AnimationFactory.js">
 83:  1: // AnimationFactory.js
 84:  2: export class AnimationFactory {
 85:  3:     // Private registry of strategies
 86:  4:     static #registry = new Map();
 87:  5:     /**
 88:  6:      * Registers a new animation strategy.
 89:  7:      * @param {string} key - The name used to identify the animation.
 90:  8:      * @param {class} StrategyClass - The class definition.
 91:  9:      */
 92: 10:     static register(key, StrategyClass) {
 93: 11:         this.#registry.set(key, StrategyClass);
 94: 12:         console.log(`Animation registered: ${key}`);
 95: 13:     }
 96: 14:     /**
 97: 15:      * Creates an instance of a registered strategy.
 98: 16:      */
 99: 17:     static create(key, config = {}) {
100: 18:         const StrategyClass = this.#registry.get(key);
101: 19:         if (!StrategyClass) {
102: 20:             console.warn(`Strategy "${key}" not found. Falling back to default.`);
103: 21:             // You can return a default or the first one registered
104: 22:             const DefaultClass = this.#registry.values().next().value;
105: 23:             return DefaultClass ? new DefaultClass(config) : null;
106: 24:         }
107: 25:         return new StrategyClass(config);
108: 26:     }
109: 27:     static getAvailableTypes() {
110: 28:         return Array.from(this.#registry.keys());
111: 29:     }
112: 30: }

<file path="VisualizerManager.js">
  1: import { CanvasItem } from './canvas/CanvasItem.js';
  2: import {VisualizerFactory, EngineFactory, visualizerManifest} from './graphs/Registry.js';
  3: import { API } from '../../core/HttpClient.js';
  4: import { BarChartEngine, WaveformEngine } from './graphs/engines/VisualizerEngines.js';
  5: import RendererFactory from './Gradient/Renderers/RendererFactory.js';
  6: import { VisualizerDropdownComponent, VisualSelectManager } from '../components/GroupeSelectItem.js';
  7: import { HTMLItems } from '../grid/RowTemplates.js';
  8: import { ListEvents } from '../../core/EventBus.js';
  9: import { AnimationFactory, ImageRenderer } from './Main.js';
 10: export const api = new API();
 11: export class BaseProcessor {
 12:     constructor() {
 13:         this.canvas = VisualizerManager.getCanvas();
 14:         this.canvasCtx = VisualizerManager.getContext();
 15:     }
 16:     setup(...args) {}
 17:     process(...args) {}
 18: }
 19: export class BGImagesProcessor extends BaseProcessor {
 20:     constructor(strategyType = 'pulse-zoom') {
 21:         super();
 22:         this.imgIdx = 0;
 23:         this.imgList = [];
 24:         this.background = null;
 25:         // Use a Factory to set the behavior
 26:         this.strategy = AnimationFactory.create(strategyType); 
 27:     }
 28:     async setup() {
 29:         // this.curImg = "def_geo.jpg";
 30:         // this.curImg = 'img1.jpg';
 31:         // this.curImg =  'binikini.jpg';
 32:         // this.curImg =  'space.jpg';
 33:         // Load the "Welcome" image first
 34:         await this._loadNext(`static/img1.jpg`);
 35:         // Load the list in the background
 36:         const res = await api.loadBGImages();
 37:         this.imgList = res['img_list'] || [];
 38:     }
 39:     async _loadNext(path) {
 40:         // Ensure we aren't encoding the "https://" or the slashes in the path 
 41:         // but we are handling special characters in the filenames.
 42:         const baseUrl = "https://audioartk.me/";
 43:         // If the path already has 'static/', we just encode the URI components 
 44:         // to handle spaces or special symbols in filenames safely.
 45:         const cleanPath = path.split('/').map(segment => encodeURIComponent(segment)).join('/');
 46:         const url = `${baseUrl}${cleanPath}`;
 47:         console.log(`Loading image ${url}`);
 48:         const img = new Image();
 49:         img.src = url;
 50:         try {
 51:             // We update this.background only after the new image has fully loaded
 52:             this.background = await this.imageLoader(img);
 53:         } catch (e) {
 54:             console.error(`Failed to load background image at ${url}`, e);
 55:         }
 56:     }
 57:     process() {
 58:         // 1. Logic: Update the strategy (the "Film")
 59:         const cycleFinished = this.strategy.update();
 60:         // 2. Management: Swap image if the "Film" is done
 61:         if (cycleFinished && this.imgList.length > 0) {
 62:             this._loadNext(this.imgList[this.imgIdx]);
 63:             this.imgIdx = (this.imgIdx + 1) % this.imgList.length;
 64:         }
 65:         // 3. Rendering: Hand everything to the Renderer
 66:         const renderContext = {
 67:             ctx: this.canvasCtx,
 68:             canvasWidth: this.canvas.attribute('width'),
 69:             canvasHeight: this.canvas.attribute('height')
 70:         };
 71:         const transform = this.strategy.getTransform(this.canvas, this.background);
 72:         // The Processor no longer draws! It just calls the Renderer.
 73:         ImageRenderer.render(renderContext, this.background, transform);
 74:     }
 75:     async imageLoader(img) {
 76:         return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
 77:             img.onload = () => resolve(img);
 78:             img.onerror = reject;
 79:         })
 80:     }
 81: }
 82: export class GraphProcessor extends BaseProcessor {
 83:     constructor(audioPlayer, category = 'waveform', chartName = 'heatmap-cycling-mirror-oscilloscope-wave', renderer = 'radial') {
 84:         super();
 85:         this.audioPlayer = audioPlayer;
 86:         this.isReady = false;
 87:         // 1. Synchronously create the initial engine/graph so .setup() works immediately
 88:         this.graph = VisualizerFactory.create(category, chartName);
 89:         this.renderer = RendererFactory.create(renderer);
 90:         this.engine = EngineFactory.create(category);
 91:         VisualizerManager.onSwitchVisualizer(this.setChart.bind(this), this);
 92:     }
 93:     async setup(fftSize) {
 94:         await this.engine.setup(this.audioPlayer, fftSize);
 95:         this.isReady = true;
 96:     }
 97:     process() {
 98:         this.engine.update();
 99:         const audioContext = this.engine.getContext();
100:         const renderContext = {
101:             ...audioContext,
102:             canvasWidth: this.canvas.attribute('width'),
103:             canvasHeight: this.canvas.attribute('height'),
104:             ctx: this.canvasCtx,
105:             canvas: this.canvas,
106:             time: Date.now() * 0.002
107:         };
108:         this.graph.process(renderContext, this.renderer);
109:     }
110:     async setChart(category, chartName, renderer) {
111:         if (!category || !chartName) return;
112:         if (!renderer) renderer = category === 'waveform' ? 'radial' : 'bar';
113:         // 2. Background creation for "Hot Swapping"
114:         const newGraph = VisualizerFactory.create(category, chartName);
115:         const newRenderer = RendererFactory.create(renderer);
116:         const newEngine = EngineFactory.create(category);
117:         // Await the setup of the NEW engine without touching the current one
118:         await newEngine.setup(this.audioPlayer);
119:         // 3. Atomic swap
120:         this.graph = newGraph;
121:         this.renderer = newRenderer;
122:         this.engine = newEngine;
123:         console.log("Visualizer swapped seamlessly.", {category, chartName, renderer});
124:     }
125: }
126: const VisualizerManager = {
127:     init() {
128:         this._initCanvas();
129:         this._processors = [];
130:         this.isRunning = false;
131:         this.animationId = null;
132:         this._events = new ListEvents();
133:         this._initVisualizerSelector();
134:     },
135:     addProcessor(processor, ...args) {
136:         this._processors.push({processor, args});
137:     },
138:     async executeProcessors() {
139:         if (this.isRunning) return;
140:         const tasks = this._processors.map(({processor, args}) => processor.setup(...args));
141:         try {
142:             await Promise.all(tasks);
143:         } catch(e) {
144:             console.trace(e);
145:             return console.error(e);
146:         }
147:         this.isRunning = true;
148:         this._stop = false;
149:         this._startMainLoop();
150:     },
151:     getCanvas() {
152:         return this.canvas;
153:     },
154:     getContext() {
155:         return this.canvasCtx;
156:     },
157:     requestStopAnimation() {
158:         if (this.animationId) {
159:             cancelAnimationFrame(this.animationId);
160:             this.animationId = null;
161:         }
162:         this.isRunning = false;
163:     },
164:     _startMainLoop() {
165:         const loop = () => {
166:             if (!this.isRunning) return;
167:             // We keep the canvas clearing and rendering at 60fps
168:             this.canvasCtx.clearRect(0, 0, this.canvas.attribute('width'), this.canvas.attribute('height'));
169:             // This will now call processor.process(), which checks its own "isReady" flag
170:             this._processors.forEach(({processor}) => processor.process());
171:             this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
172:         };
173:         this.animationId = requestAnimationFrame(loop);
174:     },
175:     _initCanvas() {
176:         this.container = new HTMLItems('div').css({
177:             position: 'relative',
178:             width: 'fit-content',
179:             margin: 'auto'
180:         }).appendTo(document.body);
181:         this.canvas = new CanvasItem({
182:             width: window.innerWidth, 
183:             height: window.innerHeight, 
184:             padWidth: 36, 
185:             padHeight: 182, 
186:             autoResize: true
187:         }).css({
188:             display: 'block',
189:             margin: 'auto'
190:         }).appendTo(this.container.render());
191:         this.canvasCtx = this.canvas.context('2d');
192:     },
193:     _initVisualizerSelector() {
194:         VisualSelectManager.init(this.container);
195:         VisualSelectManager.onCategoryChange((category, graphName, renderer) => {
196:             // NOTICE: We no longer call requestStopAnimation() here!
197:             // We just tell the processors to start their background swap.
198:             this._events.trigger('onSwitchVisualizer', category, graphName, renderer);
199:         });
200:     },
201:     onSwitchVisualizer(cb, subscriber) {
202:         this._events.onEventRegister({cb, subscriber}, 'onSwitchVisualizer');
203:     }
204: }
205: export default VisualizerManager;
</file>
